metadata.description: Community components, layouts, instruments, artifactories and spaces for the Dimension platform. Slots are open and layout-owned; well-known names are published conventions (doc 68 §4.1).

plugins.name: three-lane
plugins.description: A layout that declares its OWN slots (lane-left / lane-main / lane-dock / badge) and ships Demo Lane — the assembly-spine thesis demo: a space assembled from three plugins nobody hand-wired together.

spaces.label: Demo Lane
spaces.tagline: The assembly-spine thesis demo: a space assembled from parts nobody in this repo hand-wired — this plugin's own layout, another plugin's mark in the badge slot, and a third plugin's rail (classic-rail) filling the left lane. Its session surface takes the host's own sections; a contributed thread once filled them and the pack that did is gone, so the description no longer promises one.

plugins.name: mochi-mark
plugins.description: A mark component drawn in a declared slot of a plugin layout — the import-surface FLOOR: react only, zero @fraym/ui.

plugins.name: pulse-mark
plugins.description: The Store's demo component: a mark with zero Fraym UI reading `sessions/list` through the one granted binding, selector-gated to a single boolean — the zero-import tier demonstrated.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: Sessions - mission control in the dock: every session partitioned by urgency (needs you / working / idle), one-click switching. The first contributed dock component ("type": "component", "slot": "dock"), at the zero-import floor.

plugins.name: classic-thread
plugins.description: The shipped thread section, installable: re-exports THREAD_CLASSIC from @fraym/ui, so a space that binds it renders the REAL transcript (tool cards, metrics, presence) rather than a reduced lookalike.

plugins.name: classic-composer
plugins.description: The shipped composer section, installable: re-exports COMPOSER_CLASSIC from @fraym/ui - model picker, permission pill, attachments, mic, stop, slash catalog, all of it.

plugins.name: classic-rail
plugins.description: The shipped session rail, installable: re-exports RAIL_CLASSIC from @fraym/ui - project grouping, rail actions, search, the full row model.

plugins.name: classic-environment
plugins.description: The shipped environment card, installable: re-exports ENVIRONMENT_CLASSIC from @fraym/ui - live SCM scan, submodule pins, worktree verbs, Push.

plugins.name: code-assembled
plugins.description: Code (Assembled) - the Code space's SESSION SURFACE reproduced 1:1 from marketplace parts. Its space document mirrors Dimension's compiled-in CODE field for field, and every filling is a pack shipping the real component. The parity harness: put its session surface beside Code's and any visible difference is a hole in the assembly contract. Its top-bar chrome is at parity too: the same five controls the built-in Code space declares, so the dock toggle draws here as it does there.

spaces.label: Code (Assembled)
spaces.tagline: The full Code experience, assembled entirely from marketplace parts — pixel-identical to the built-in.

plugins.name: classic-dock
plugins.description: The shipped dock COLUMN as a pack — tab strip, resize handle, panel body. Fills the `dock-column` contract (a `dock` component is an instrument, i.e. one tab).

plugins.name: classic-workspace
plugins.description: The shipped workspace host as a pack — the center pane's splits, tiling and overlays. The first marketplace part to ever fill the `workspace` contract.

plugins.name: classic-switcher
plugins.description: The shipped switcher rail as a pack — the far-left column of space marks.

plugins.name: independent-composer
plugins.description: A composer built independently on the bricks tier — Fraym primitives + tokens + the store channels. Ships no shipped-implementation import.

plugins.name: independent-thread
plugins.description: Independent thread section assembled from the published PARTS (Thread, SectionSessionScope, PresenceSurface, OpeningThreadSkeleton) — no shipped implementation imported.

plugins.name: independent-rail
plugins.description: Independent session rail assembled from the published PARTS (SessionRail, the rail chrome, and the three assembly hooks) - imports no shipped rail implementation. Speaks the rail slot's specVersion 2 channel contract.
